title: SMART Guideline End to End Output
description: Every stage's artefact, in order, and where each stage's adjudication stands. The guideline is done only when every adjudication is recorded.

adjudications.description: One per stage that produced something, 1 to 8b.

adjudication.title: Stage adjudication
adjudication.description: Where a stage's review stands. The record itself is a cat-harness QaReview (qa-review/v1); this only points at it. Defined by the smart-guideline-end-to-end output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

outcome.description: pending until a person records the verdict; the agent never records one.

application.title: Application
application.description: The built consuming application and its tests. Defined by the l4-application-build output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

path.description: Repository-relative directory of the application, or its repository URL.

url.description: Where it runs on the staging preview.

against.description: The IG it was built against: igRoot, or packageId#version. A clean build, not necessarily a publication.

kind.description: conformance: against the IG's examples and test cases. scenario: an L2 user scenario walked through.

subject.description: The IG example, test case or L2 user scenario id it checks.

applicationBrief.title: Application brief
applicationBrief.description: What the consuming application is, in the requester's words where they gave any. Defined by the l4-application-brief output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

topic.description: Kebab-case name of the application, used as the wireframe topic.

kind.description: The option chosen: a point-of-care app, a reporting or indicator dashboard, a decision-support service an EMR calls, or something else.

users.description: The L2 persona ids who use it.

l2Processes.description: The L2 business-process ids it covers.

l3Resources.description: Canonicals of the L3 resources it reads or writes.

operations.description: FHIR operations it calls: $apply, $evaluate-measure, CDS Hooks services.

systems.description: The systems it talks to: an EMR, a registry, a reporting server.

dependencyChoice.title: Dependency choice
dependencyChoice.description: The output of a dependency-choice stage (3 at L2, 5 at L3): one row per candidate, rejected ones included, the gaps, and the question put to the adjudicator. Defined by the l2-dependency-choice output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

gaps.description: Candidates missing packageId, version or uri (DependsOnGap), each with what is missing.

decisionRequest.description: Path or URL of the DecisionRequest (cat-harness schemas/decision-request.ts) the adjudicator answers. Under the QA rule the agent has already gone on with its recommendation.

dependencyRow.title: Dependency decision row
dependencyRow.description: One candidate and the decision about it. Only decision, reason and toolchain are new; the rest is cat-harness DependsOnRecord and smart-base KG evidence. Once adjudicated, a reuse, adapt or extend row becomes an ordinary dependency: the DAK's own reference at L2, a sushi-config.yaml dependencies entry at L3. Defined by the l2-dependency-choice output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

upstream.description: For a jurisdiction's adaptation: the packageId of the WHO original, recorded as its upstream.

evidence.description: The KG node ids that point at the candidate: L1 nodes at L2; L1 nodes and L2 assets at L3 (smart-base KG evidence).

decision.description: reuse: unchanged. adapt: fork and change. extend: depend and add. reject: not used.

reason.description: One sentence; required for reject (stated here rather than as if/then, which the conformance reader does not take).

id.description: A DAK component at L2 (personas, business-processes, ...); a profile, value set or library canonical at L3.

toolchain.description: For a component reused, adapted or extended: how the candidate produces it, so stages 4 and 6 produce it the same way. A Tool id from bun run cat check:tools, or a script in the candidate's own repository (its source spreadsheet, converter, CQL refresh, test format), found by the search in smart-base-tools section Adapting a DAK. none only after that search came back empty, naming where it looked; the new tool is then a Tool node, never a script in the adaptation repository.

components.description: What is taken from the candidate, piece by piece.

igBuild.title: IG build
igBuild.description: Stage 6's result as later stages read it: where the IG is and what it generated. The fields are fhir-harness l3-fhir-authoring's output (sushiResult, generatedResources), plus where the IG root is. Defined by the l4-application-brief input contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

l1Extraction.title: L1 extraction
l1Extraction.description: One source's L1 knowledge graph. Defined by the recommendation-extraction output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

id.description: The library id of the source.

coverage.description: Share of the source's recommendation sentences extracted verbatim; the gate is 1.

warnings.description: Every WARNING, verbatim: no persona or process fitted, a sentence not matched, and so on.

skipped.description: True when the extraction was already there at this sourceVersion and was not redone.

l1Kg.title: L1 knowledge graph
l1Kg.description: Stage 2's output and the L1 input of stages 3 and 5: one extraction per included source. Defined by the recommendation-extraction output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

l1Source.title: L1 source
l1Source.description: One candidate L1 guideline, with whether it is used and how far it has been taken. Defined by the dak-l1-library output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

id.description: The library id (the bib key), or a provisional id for a source not yet in the library.

uri.description: Where it is published: a WHO IRIS handle, a DOI, a URL.

status.description: in-library: library/<bib>/ exists; in-kg: library/<bib>/l1-extraction/ exists at this sourceVersion; not-yet: neither.

sourceVersion.description: The version or date of the source the library holds.

included.description: Whether the source bears on the use case.

reason.description: One sentence: why it was included or left out.

l1SourceList.title: L1 source list
l1SourceList.description: Stage 1's output and stage 2's input: the candidate L1 sources for a use case. Defined by the dak-l1-library output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

l2Artifact.title: L2 artifact
l2Artifact.description: One L2 asset the authoring wrote. Defined by the l2-dak-authoring output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

useCase.title: Use case
useCase.description: What the guideline is for, in the requester's words. Stage 0's output and every later stage's context. Defined by the guideline-use-case output contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

setting.description: Where care happens: community, primary care, hospital, and so on.

jurisdiction.description: WHO (a global guideline) or the country or region adapting one; an ISO 3166 code where there is one.

kind.description: A new guideline, or an adaptation of an existing one.

adapts.description: For an adaptation: the guideline or DAK being adapted, by name or canonical.

wireframeChoice.title: Wireframe choice
wireframeChoice.description: What stage 8b reads from cat-harness wireframe-design-review's output: where the drawings are and which candidate was chosen. The fields are that contract's. Defined by the l4-application-build input contract and copied inline wherever it is passed on; the stage chain check compares the copies.

stagingLinks.title: Staging links
stagingLinks.description: The staging preview of the work a request for feedback is about: one deep link per changed page (the page and the anchor where the change sits) with the same page on main as `before`. Mirrors StagingComparison in schemas/staging.ts. The rule is skills/sdlc/sdlc-core/staging-review.md §"The deep-link rule". Copied inline as `definitions.stagingLinks` into every skill contract that carries it; schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.

slug.description: Branch slug used in the staging URL path.

pages.description: One entry per changed page, deep-linked; from the change's rendered-impact list, never chosen by judgement.

before.description: Same page on main; absent for a new page.

after.description: The page on the staging preview, with the anchor where the change sits; absent for a deleted page.

summary.description: What to look at on this page.

missing.description: What could not be linked, said rather than hidden: no preview yet (and when it will exist), no page list computed, or a changed page the publish ref does not hold.

stagingLinks.$comment: Copy of cat-harness schemas/staging-comparison.schema.json; cat-harness schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.
